# Toledo Technologies

Toledo Technologies is Nicholas Toledo's founder-led software practice. Nicholas
is the default technical lead and implementer. Any specialist or collaborator is
disclosed before their work enters an engagement.

Contact: hello@toledotechnologies.com · https://toledotechnologies.com/contact

## Services and published starting points
- Custom websites — $5,500+
- Custom web applications — $15,000+
- Native mobile applications — $50,000+
- Cross-platform mobile applications — $65,000+
- AI automation and governed-agent work — $10,000+
- SiteLift WordPress-exit migration — $3,500+
- Care plans — $750/month+

## Paid discovery
- SiteLift Fit Check — $750 fixed
- Website Migration Audit — $1,500 fixed
- Web App Discovery — $3,500–$5,000
- AI Automation Blueprint — $3,500–$10,000
- Mobile App Discovery — $5,000–$7,500
- SaaS / Product Strategy — $7,500–$15,000

Discovery is paid 100% upfront. For a qualifying project started within 30 days,
50% of the discovery fee is credited to the kickoff Project Retainer. The credit
is capped at that Project Retainer; unused credit lapses and does not roll
forward. The
discovery document remains usable whether or not Toledo is hired for implementation.

## Toledo-operated software
- Tessera free bounded evidence check — no account
- PCI DSS 6.4.3 written remediation pack — $299 once
- PCI DSS 5.4.1 email-authentication remediation pack — $99 once
- PCI DSS 11.6.1 one-target evidence ledger — $99/month, evaluated every 72 hours

Tessera reports bounded software-generated evidence for qualified human review; it
does not determine PCI DSS compliance. Public synthetic samples are available before
checkout: https://qi.toledotechnologies.com/pci-4-compliance-scanner

Free MIT served-HTML inventory Action (does not execute JavaScript or certify
compliance): https://github.com/ntoledo319/pci-payment-page-check
GitHub Marketplace: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/pci-payment-page-script-check
Reviewer-owned inventory template:
https://qi.toledotechnologies.com/pci/pci-dss-6-4-3-script-inventory-template

## Evidence labels
- Field notes identify independent public research and its limitations.
- Sample deliverables are labeled as samples and are not presented as client work.
- A public research note is not automatically a paid client engagement or a promised outcome.
